summary.pack_description:
Collect 3 highlights celebrating the career of Detroit Red Wings icon Steve Yzerman with The Captain’s Masterpieces Pack! Created in collaboration with the Detroit Red Wings, these new highlights memorialize milestones and key highlights from Yzerman’s 22-season career with the Detroit Red Wings.

This commemorative collection will be released on January 14th, the date the team and fans will celebrate Steve Yzerman as part of Hockeytown Throwback Nights across the 2024-25 season.

Each pack contains 2 mystery highlights that could be Yzerman scoring his 691st, and final goal at Joe Louis Arena passing Mario Lemieux on the all-time goal-scoring list, placing him 8th at the time (Rare #/250), dismantling the Philadelphia Flyers defense in a hat trick-completing goal during the 1988-89 season (Limited #/500), or his 50th goal versus the Edmonton Oilers during the 1992-93 season (Core #/1500).

release.name: The Captain’s Masterpieces Pack
release.description:
DROP SOLD OUT! Packs available in the Marketplace from other collectors

Sale Starts: Tuesday, January 14, 2025 at 1pm ET / 10am PT

 

Price: $5 USD

# Packs Available: 1,125. Edition numbers are distributed randomly.

 

Purchase Limit: Ten (10) pack limit per person for the first 6 hours; limit increased to twenty (20) pack limit per person afterwards. Once the “Buy Now” process has started, users will have 10 minutes to complete checkout before the pack(s) is released for another collector to purchase.

 

Highlights Per Pack: 2

Pack Contents (Highlight Rarity, Edition Size):

  • Two (2) highlights with the following probabilities:
    • 66.67% 50th goal versus the Edmonton Oilers during the 1992-93 season (Core #/1500)
    • 22.22% Dismantling the Philadelphia Flyers defense in a hat trick-completing goal during the 1988-89 season (Limited #/500)
    • 11.11% Passing Mario Lemieux on the all-time goal-scoring list, placing him 8th at the time with 691st, and final goal at Joe Louis Arena (Rare #/250)



Payment Methods Accepted: Most major credit and debit cards. Payments will be made via registered payment processor MoonPay where available; where not available, payments will be processed via Stripe. Payment via cryptocurrency is also available. See these FAQs for a complete list of supported currencies.

 

Fan Marketplace: Packs and highlights are eligible to be sold to other collectors in the NHL Breakaway fan marketplace. See FAQ.

 

Transferability: Packs and highlights can be exchanged in the Trade Lounge™ with other NHL Breakaway users.

 

Blockchain: Polygon

 

Sets Included:

  • Hometown History: Detroit Red Wings, Series 2 - Preview

 

Collection Guarantee: Series 2 highlights will only be distributed during Series 2, which ends prior to the start of the 2025-26 Regular Season. We will not issue more than the edition limit we have set. Any editions not distributed in packs will not be distributed after the series end date (See FAQ for “Uncirculated Editions”)

 

All sales subject to Terms

summary.name: Steve Yzerman
summary.description:
Steve Yzerman, the Detroit Red Wings' captain for an unparalleled 22 seasons, was an unstoppable force on the ice. He reached the 50-goal mark in five different seasons, amassing an incredible 692 career goals. During the 1992-93 season, Yzerman notched his 50th goal in a game against Edmonton with a play that showcased his skill and elusiveness. Receiving a pass in full stride, Yzerman streaked down the ice, deftly maneuvered around a defenseman, and fired a shot five-hole to cap off the milestone in style.

Officially Licensed Product of the NHL, NHLPA, and/or NHLAA. All copyright, logos, and marks are the property of their respective owners and are used, under license, by Sweet. All Rights Reserved. [Terms Apply](https://nhlbreakaway.com/terms).

summary.name: Steve Yzerman
summary.description:
Throughout his remarkable 22-season career as the Detroit Red Wings' captain, Steve Yzerman delivered countless jaw-dropping moments that left fans and teammates in awe. One unforgettable play came during a road game against the Flyers. Carrying the puck up the ice, Yzerman approached multiple defenders, gained the blue line, and effortlessly evaded the first check. With dazzling moves, he dangled past a defenseman before outmaneuvering the goalie to score a sensational goal—his third of the game, completing a hat trick. That 1988-89 season, Yzerman's brilliance earned him the Lester B. Pearson Award (now the Ted Lindsay Award), recognizing him as the NHLPA’s Most Outstanding Player.

Officially Licensed Product of the NHL, NHLPA, and/or NHLAA. All copyright, logos, and marks are the property of their respective owners and are used, under license, by Sweet. All Rights Reserved. [Terms Apply](https://nhlbreakaway.com/terms).

summary.name: Steve Yzerman
summary.description:
In his final season with the Detroit Red Wings, 22-season team captain Steve Yzerman delivered a memorable moment at Joe Louis Arena on March 31, 2006. Capitalizing on a play he disrupted at the blue line that led to a Chicago turnover, Yzerman found himself in the slot and hammered home a pass for his 691st career goal. This goal moved him past Mario Lemieux on the all-time goal-scoring list, placing him 8th at the time. Adding to an already legendary career, Yzerman’s accolades include three Stanley Cup championships, a Conn Smythe Trophy, a Frank J. Selke Trophy, and induction into the Hockey Hall of Fame.
